summary: Contribution by Kristian Muri Knausgård. Derived from Bei Yi's beiyi-ten-d250-t022, building on Rishi Khan (TEN), Samuel Lavery/team (OpethN/am-cert/bridge-port), R. Arun Chandru (master-of-puppets), Yuhang Shi, ajp88, AMTOPA, Zero Forge/cafeai (zfNat64), Zeta Lab, Anthropic (Zeta23) and Knausgård's Lean work for arXiv:2609.33043 and arXiv:2610.08965. Jointly re-optimises the 16-harmonic cosine window and 10-point weights a_ij, b_r and floor c by cutting-plane LP. Uses an order-36 Taylor enclosure and an H_W floor with denominator 10^50. Regenerates pyramids, convexity cover, 5,385 tangent entries and walk payload (1,138 additional splits, 29,555 term leaves); re-partitions cleared root-cover intervals with unchanged root boxes. Upstream copyright, license and attribution notices retained.
method: Joint LP co-optimisation of the 16-harmonic cosine window and 10-point certificate weights with regenerated Lean pyramids, tangent table and leaf set (H_W floor with denominator 10^50)
model: Gemini 4 Argon; Claude Fable 5.2 and 5.1; Claude Opus 5.5
